title: CLI fails closed: no silent AWS credential fallback
description: graphql_request_headers (src/papyrus_content/graphql_http.py) signs with the AWS credential chain when no user session file exists and PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH is unset. Make the signed-in user the default: with no session, refuse and say to run papyrus login. IAM only on an explicit opt-in, for workers and the listed break-glass commands. Update the error guidance in operator_errors.py and cli_user_auth.py that tells people to set AWS_PROFILE. Check every worker and scheduled job that relies on the default sets the opt-in before this ships. Gherkin required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/PPY-5f119a-fail-closed (PR against develop, not merged). graphql_request_headers now refuses with 'run papyrus login' (exit 2) unless PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam is set; knowledge query auto/remote refuses unless --execution local or iam. Workers declare the opt-in in image/stack definitions in the same PR (see PR body for deploy order). Backend suite: 173 features pass; remaining 2 errors are stale local venv (httpcore2). Test isolation fixed in conftest.py and features_backend/environment.py.
